note: Checked-in AI test cases for the demo API. Replaying these makes the demo deterministic and removes the need for a model or API key. Regenerate with: breach-gate scan --config security.config.yml (with scanners.ai.replayTests removed and a provider configured).

tests.name: SQL injection via id parameter
tests.description: Inject a single quote into the id parameter to break the query

tests.name: Command injection via command field
tests.description: Chain a second command using a shell metacharacter

tests.name: Path traversal via path parameter
tests.description: Escape the intended directory to read a system file

tests.name: Reflected XSS via search query
tests.description: Reflect a script tag into the HTML response unescaped

tests.name: Debug endpoint exposes internals
tests.description: Unauthenticated access to environment and user listing

tests.name: Sensitive data in user lookup
tests.description: User record returns a password hint to an unauthenticated caller

tests.name: Login with a benign credential pair
tests.description: Control case: a normal failed login must not be reported as a finding
